units.source_text: 内大臣说：“女子只要性情好，便能专宠得势。”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said, "As long as a woman has a good nature, she can win exclusive favor and rise in power."

units.source_text: 他谈论别人，却想起了自己的女儿，接着说道：“

en.t: While speaking of others, he thought of his own daughter and went on, "

units.source_text: 我抚育弘徽殿女御时，力求其完美无缺，万事不逊于人，

en.t: When I raised the Kokiden Consort, I tried to make her flawless, inferior to no one in anything,

units.source_text: 想不到竟被梅壶压倒了。

en.t: yet unexpectedly she was overshadowed by Umetsubo.

units.source_text: 我看到这命运，痛感人世之事真不可逆料啊！

en.t: Seeing this fate, I keenly felt how truly unpredictable human affairs are.

units.source_text: 至少这个云居雁，我总要设法让她当皇后。

en.t: At the very least, I must somehow make this Kumoi no Kari become empress.

units.source_text: 皇太子的冠礼，是不多几年后的事了。

en.t: The Crown Prince's coming-of-age ceremony is only a few years away.

units.source_text: 我正在私下考虑，指望成遂此志，

en.t: I have been considering it privately, hoping to fulfill this wish,

units.source_text: 却不料这个幸运的明石姬生了一个可配太子的女儿，

en.t: but unexpectedly that fortunate Lady Akashi has given birth to a daughter fit for the Crown Prince,
and now that child has come to compete with Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 这个女儿倘进了宫，恐怕没有人争得过她吧！”

en.t: If that daughter enters the palace, I fear no one will be able to rival her!"
As he said this, he sighed again and again.
The elderly lady said, "How can that be right!

units.source_text: 你父亲生前说过：我们家里不会不出皇后。

en.t: Your father said while he was alive: surely an empress will come from our family.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御之事，他也十分用心出力。

en.t: He also devoted great care and effort to the matter of the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 要是他还在世间，不会有此种乖谬之事。”

en.t: If he were still in this world, such a perverse thing would never have happened."

units.source_text: 为了弘徽殿女御不能立后之事，

en.t: Because the Kokiden Consort had not been made empress,

units.source_text: 太君对源氏太政大臣不免怀恨。

en.t: the elderly lady could not help bearing resentment toward Genji, the Grand Minister.
